SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
File No.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Foreign Office REGISTRY.
No. 8
Date Sept 30, 1929
Time 30. 9. 29.）
Subject (in full) Departure of Soviet Agents.
Made by D.S. Oviannikoff. Forwarded by H.W. Robertson D.I.
Sir,
The undermentioned Soviet Agents left Shanghai for
Kobe via Nagasaki in the s.s. Nagasaki Maru on September
27, 1929.
Comrade A.C. Bilan Soviet Agent, Manager of the
local branch of the Far Eastern
Bank (Dalbank). Resided at
808 F. Rue Lafayette.
Mrs. A.C. Bilan alias
Alexandroff Soviet Agent. Wife of the above.
V. Ovsiannikoff
D. S.
A/D. C. I.

28.9.29）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. 1 Q. D. 47 Stations
Date 19. 2. 29.
Date February 19th 1929.）

Subject (in full) Arrival of Soviet employee.

Made by D.S. Ovsianikoff Forwarded by J. Williams A.C. P.R.

Sir,
The undermentioned Soviet Employee arrived here from
Soviet Russia via Harbin and Dairen on February 6 by the S.S.
"Dairen Maru".

Mr. Alex. J. Bilan. Soviet employee and newly appointed
Manager of the local office of
"Dalbank". Resides in French
Concession. His political views
are unknown at present.

Mrs. A.J. Bilan. Wife of the above.

I. Ovsianikoff
D. S.

a/D.J.I.

J.W.

MR. 19/2/29

Ref. No. d/February 19, 1929.
Copy forwarded to H.B.M. Consul for information.
Lt. Col. G.H.R. Holland, O.B.E.
Capt. J.P. Shelley.
Lieut. E.F. Carlson.

BILAN, Alex. C. - Soviet
Soviet Agent, Manager of the local branch of the
Far Eastern Bank (Dalbank).
Resided at 606 P. Rue Lafayette.

BILAN, Mrs. A. C. - alias ALEXANDROFF
Wife of the above.

SMP
SMP No. I.O.D.48
30 Sept. 1929
